function.name: exa-search-deep_researcher_start
function.description: Start a comprehensive AI-powered deep research task for complex queries. This tool initiates an intelligent agent that performs extensive web searches, crawls relevant pages, analyzes information, and synthesizes findings into a detailed research report. The agent thinks critically about the research topic and provides thorough, well-sourced answers. Use this for complex research questions that require in-depth analysis rather than simple searches. After starting a research task, IMMEDIATELY use deep_researcher_check with the returned task ID to monitor progress and retrieve results.

instructions.description: Complex research question or detailed instructions for the AI researcher. Be specific about what you want to research and any particular aspects you want covered.

model.description: Research model: 'exa-research' (faster, 15-45s, good for most queries) or 'exa-research-pro' (more comprehensive, 45s-2min, for complex topics). Default: exa-research

function.name: exa-search-deep_researcher_check
function.description: Check the status and retrieve results of a deep research task. This tool monitors the progress of an AI agent that performs comprehensive web searches, analyzes multiple sources, and synthesizes findings into detailed research reports. The tool includes a built-in 5-second delay before checking to allow processing time. IMPORTANT: You must call this tool repeatedly (poll) until the status becomes 'completed' to get the final research results. When status is 'running', wait a few seconds and call this tool again with the same task ID.

taskId.description: The task ID returned from deep_researcher_start tool

function.name: unity-mcp-integration-execute_editor_command
function.description: Execute C# code directly in the Unity Editor - allows full flexibility including custom namespaces and multiple classes

code.description: C# code to execute in Unity Editor. You MUST define a public class named "McpScript" with a public static method named "Execute" that returns an object. Example: "public class McpScript { public static object Execute() { /* your code here */ return result; } }". You can include any necessary namespaces, additional classes, and methods.

timestampBefore.description: Filter logs before this ISO timestamp

function.name: unity-mcp-integration-read_file
function.description: Read the contents of a file from the Unity project. Paths are relative to the project's Assets folder. For example, use 'Scenes/MainScene.unity' to read Assets/Scenes/MainScene.unity.

path.description: Path to the file to read. Can be absolute or relative to Unity project Assets folder. If empty, defaults to the Assets folder.

function.name: unity-mcp-integration-read_multiple_files
function.description: Read the contents of multiple files from the Unity project simultaneously.

paths.description: Array of file paths to read. Paths can be absolute or relative to Unity project Assets folder.

function.name: unity-mcp-integration-write_file
function.description: Create a new file or completely overwrite an existing file in the Unity project.

path.description: Path to the file to write. Can be absolute or relative to Unity project Assets folder. If empty, defaults to the Assets folder.

content.description: Content to write to the file

function.name: unity-mcp-integration-edit_file
function.description: Make precise edits to a text file in the Unity project. Returns a git-style diff showing changes.

path.description: Path to the file to edit. Can be absolute or relative to Unity project Assets folder. If empty, defaults to the Assets folder.

oldText.description: Text to search for - must match exactly

edits.description: Array of edit operations to apply

dryRun.description: Preview changes using git-style diff format

function.name: unity-mcp-integration-list_directory
function.description: Get a listing of all files and directories in a specified path in the Unity project. Paths are relative to the Assets folder unless absolute. For example, use 'Scenes' to list all files in Assets/Scenes directory. Use empty string to list the Assets folder.

path.description: Path to the directory to list. Can be absolute or relative to Unity project Assets folder. If empty, defaults to the Assets folder. Example: "Scenes" will list all files in the Assets/Scenes directory.

function.name: unity-mcp-integration-directory_tree
function.description: Get a recursive tree view of files and directories in the Unity project as a JSON structure.

path.description: Path to the directory to get tree of. Can be absolute or relative to Unity project Assets folder. If empty, defaults to the Assets folder. Example: "Prefabs" will show the tree for Assets/Prefabs.

function.name: unity-mcp-integration-search_files
function.description: Recursively search for files and directories matching a pattern in the Unity project.

path.description: Path to search from. Can be absolute or relative to Unity project Assets folder. If empty, defaults to the Assets folder. Example: "Scripts" will search within Assets/Scripts.

function.name: unity-mcp-integration-get_file_info
function.description: Retrieve detailed metadata about a file or directory in the Unity project.

path.description: Path to the file to get info for. Can be absolute or relative to Unity project Assets folder. If empty, defaults to the Assets folder.

function.name: unity-mcp-integration-find_assets_by_type
function.description: Find all Unity assets of a specified type (e.g., Material, Prefab, Scene, Script) in the project. Set searchPath to an empty string to search the entire Assets folder.

searchPath.description: Directory to search in. Can be absolute or relative to Unity project Assets folder. An empty string will search the entire Assets folder.

maxDepth.description: Maximum depth to search. 1 means search only in the specified directory, 2 includes immediate subdirectories, and so on. Set to -1 for unlimited depth.
